title: Datardo's settings
description: Every setting of Datardo, by its full name. Each is a row of docs/features/settings.md (R8.4).

datardo.window.zoom.title: Zoom
datardo.window.zoom.description: The size of everything in the window, in percent.

datardo.window.checkForUpdates.title: Check for a newer version
datardo.window.checkForUpdates.description: Whether Datardo asks GitHub, at start and once a day, if a newer version exists. Nothing is downloaded.

datardo.tab.restore.title: Restore tabs at start
datardo.tab.restore.description: Whether the tabs open at quit come back at the next start.

datardo.runner.systemNotifications.title: Notify when long work ends
datardo.runner.systemNotifications.description: Whether long work that ends while the window is not in front shows a notification of the system.

datardo.query.timeLimitSeconds.title: Time limit of a query, in seconds
datardo.query.timeLimitSeconds.description: How long the server may work on one query before it is stopped.

datardo.relation.detect.title: Find references between collections
datardo.relation.detect.description: Whether references between collections are found when a database is opened.

datardo.undo.enabled.title: Keep the undo history
datardo.undo.enabled.description: Whether writes to documents and keys are kept in the undo history.

datardo.undo.maxSizeMb.title: Disk space, in MB
datardo.undo.maxSizeMb.description: The most disk space the undo history takes, in MB.

datardo.undo.maxDays.title: Days to keep
datardo.undo.maxDays.description: How many days an operation is kept.

datardo.undo.maxDocumentsPerOperation.title: Documents or keys in one operation
datardo.undo.maxDocumentsPerOperation.description: The most documents or keys one operation keeps; a larger write is not recorded.

datardo.undo.maxOperationSizeMb.title: Data in one operation, in MB
datardo.undo.maxOperationSizeMb.description: The most data one operation keeps, in MB; a larger write is not recorded.

datardo.task.keepRunningInTray.title: Keep running in the tray
datardo.task.keepRunningInTray.description: Whether closing the window keeps Datardo in the tray while a scheduled task is enabled.

datardo.mcp.port.title: Port
datardo.mcp.port.description: The port of the MCP server on 127.0.0.1.

datardo.mcp.readData.title: Let assistants read data
datardo.mcp.readData.description: Whether the tools of the MCP server may return documents and the values of keys. Off, the tools that return them and explain_query are not offered, count_documents gives only totals, and what could quote a value (commands, validators, view pipelines, partial filters, saved queries, a server's error) is reduced to its shape or its code.

datardo.key.separator.title: Separator of namespaces
datardo.key.separator.description: The text key names are split at to make namespaces.

datardo.console.historySize.title: Commands remembered
datardo.console.historySize.description: How many commands of the console are remembered for each connection.
